answers.label: Change in procurement price for EACs
Drivers of procurement price differences
selections: Hourly matching and deliverability requirements may change prices due to supply available at specific times and locations of demand
answers.text: Hourly matching and deliverability requirements may change prices due to supply available at specific times and locations of demand ;

answers.label: Comments on opposition to exemptions
answers.text:
1. The hourly supply of purchased electricity is not consistent; it varies over time.

2. Hourly renewable electricity generation fluctuates significantly.

3. If RECs are purchased with strict hourly matching, the resulting offset percentage may be very low
